title: The Lost Hat (a play)
retell: Read it again with a friend or family member. Each person reads one part. Use your character’s voice!

pages.text: Reader: It is a windy morning in the woods.
Fox: Oh no! The wind took my hat!
Duck: What hat? A red hat with a green feather?
Fox: Yes! That is my best hat.
Owl: Hoot! I can see a red hat up in the tree.
Duck: I will flap up and get it. Flap, flap, flap!
Reader: Duck flaps and flaps, but Duck cannot get up so high.
Owl: Let me help. I am good at this.
Reader: Owl swoops up and grabs the hat with her feet.
Fox: My hat! Thank you, Owl. Thank you, Duck.
Duck: Next time, tie it on with a string!

questions.q: How should Fox sound when the hat blows away?
